items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: He didn't come around there at all. Buddy Barley never made it. He was running the place.

ctx.x: Did he just ran the place? Did he do anything else? No, he didn't. I didn't know what he got. He was the boss around there. Yeah, that's it. You can't run this thing. You can't run this thing. You can't run the white man.
You can't run this thing. Well, we seen him. He didn't come around there at all. Buddy Barley never made it. He was running the place. Mm-hmm.
